Overview

Žilina is a city in Žilina Region with a population of 82,656. A key transport hub in northwestern Slovakia, surrounded by the Malá Fatra mountains, with a charming old town and a growing automotive industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
